--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[DB-1] Unbounded product listing (no pagination)
File: src/app/api/products/route.ts (L1-L120)
Evidence: prisma.product.findMany(...) is called with include: { colors } and orderBy but no take/skip or cursor, returning the entire products table per request. This will return all product rows (and related colors) on every request.
Impact: At modest traffic (10x typical QPS) this causes DB CPU/IOPS exhaustion and severe latency spikes as table size grows; user-facing list endpoints will become slow or time out.  
Fix: Add cursor/limit-based pagination (take/skip or cursor), return only necessary fields, and eager-load colors only when needed.

[DB-2] Order creation lacks atomic transaction and has per-item DB loops
File: src/app/api/checkout/create-order/route.ts (L1-L260)
Evidence: Coupon is read then updated in separate calls, and order/item updates/creates/deletes are done as independent prisma calls inside loops (multiple awaits) without a single $transaction spanning coupon decrement + order creation/upserts.  
Impact: Concurrent checkouts can over-redeem limited coupons and leave partially updated orders (data inconsistency) under modest concurrent checkout load (~tens of concurrent requests), causing financial/state corruption.

--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[DB-1] Unbounded product listing (no pagination)
File: src/app/api/products/route.ts (L1-L120)
Evidence: prisma.product.findMany(...) is called with include: { colors } and orderBy but no take/skip or cursor, returning the entire products table per request. This will return all product rows (and related colors) on every request.
Impact: At modest traffic (10x typical QPS) this causes DB CPU/IOPS exhaustion and severe latency spikes as table size grows; user-facing list endpoints will become slow or time out.  
Fix: Add cursor/limit-based pagination (take/skip or cursor), return only necessary fields, and eager-load colors only when needed.

[DB-2] Order creation lacks atomic transaction and has per-item DB loops
File: src/app/api/checkout/create-order/route.ts (L1-L260)
Evidence: Coupon is read then updated in separate calls, and order/item updates/creates/deletes are done as independent prisma calls inside loops (multiple awaits) without a single $transaction spanning coupon decrement + order creation/upserts.  
Impact: Concurrent checkouts can over-redeem limited coupons and leave partially updated orders (data inconsistency) under modest concurrent checkout load (~tens of concurrent requests), causing financial/state corruption.  
Fix: Wrap coupon validation+decrement and the full order create/update + orderItems upserts/deletes in a single DB transaction (prisma.$transaction) and use conditional decrement (WHERE quantity > 0) or SELECT ... FOR UPDATE semantics to make coupon decrement atomic.

[DB-3] Prisma client not globally cached in production (serverless connection risk)
File: src/lib/prisma.ts (L1-L40)
Evidence: PrismaClient is instantiated at module scope but only cached on globalThis when NODE_ENV !== "production", so production does not reuse a global singleton across cold starts/instances.  
Impact: On serverless platforms this increases total DB connections across many instances and can exhaust DB connection limits or cause connection errors at tens-to-hundreds of concurrent lambdas.  
Fix: Cache the PrismaClient on globalThis (or use a pooler) in all environments and deploy a connection pooler (PgBouncer/hosted pool) for serverless deployments.

--- WARNING FINDINGS ---

[DB-4] Missing indexes on order_items foreign keys
File: prisma/schema.prisma (OrderItem model) (L1-L120)
Evidence: OrderItem defines orderId and productId FKs but has no @@index on orderId or productId; many routes include orderItems by order id.  
Impact: order.includes/order lookups will trigger table scans on order_items as it grows, increasing DB CPU and latency for order-related flows under scale.  
Fix: Add indexes (e.g., @@index([orderId]) and @@index([productId])) to order_items and deploy with migration; consider composite indexes if queries filter by multiple columns.

[DB-5] Category/product filters and sorting unindexed and unpaginated
File: src/app/api/products/category/[category]/route.ts (L1-L220)
Evidence: findMany(...) accepts price/stock filters and orderBy createdAt/name/price but returns all matching rows with no pagination; schema lacks indexes on price and createdAt for products.  
Impact: Filtering and sorting will cause full-table scans and expensive sorts, degrading latency and increasing DB IOPS under high read QPS.  
Fix: Enforce paginated responses and add indexes on frequently filtered/sorted columns (price, createdAt); restrict selected fields returned.

--- INFO ---

[DB-6] Correct use of transactions in cart and payment flows
File: src/app/api/cart/items/route.ts and src/app/api/checkout/verify-payment/route.ts
Evidence: prisma.$transaction used to update cart totals atomically and to confirm order + decrement stock in payment verification.
